title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode5 Because I'm an Idol

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And why on Earth would we want to help you practice?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's true we've only just met...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's just, I've been practicing dancing and singing by myself up until now, so there's still a lot I don't know.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know I don't have any right to ask you for help, but I thought if I could learn from such great idols like you that it might help me get closer to my dream!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to keep improving. More, more! So I can become an idol! Please...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You said your name was Minori, right? I'm usually busy with work, so I can only help on my days off. Is that all right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes, of course! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What are you thinking? What about your own work?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're the one that said it, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Idols should never ignore those who dream of becoming idols themselves.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... Fine. All I have to do is give a little advice, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But if you fail your next audition, I'm out! You got that?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right! Th-Thank you very much!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's great, Minori. I'm glad they agreed to help you practice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm sorry you never got the chance to sit down and read, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What was with that Miku video, though?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I have no idea. It sure was strange.
Actually, this entire day has been rather strange.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So you want to be an idol, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Hehe. Though it feels a little odd telling you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're actually the reason I wanted to become an idol in the first place, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My dream is to take all the hope you've given me and pass it on to even more people.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's why I need to practice, especially now that I have some coaches! More, more!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...
The next day

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hinomori! Momoi! Thank you so much for coming!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Hi, Minori. We'll do out best to help however we can.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I trust you've already warmed up with some stretches?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes! I wanted to make sure I didn't waste any time!
I'm all ready to go!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, at least you seem to have the right attitude.
One question, though. What is Haruka Kiritani doing reading over there?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, she said she likes it here because it's quiet and not too many people come up here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Dance practice isn't exactly a quiet activity, you know.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That reminds me. How are you with interviews? Initial screenings have nothing to do with dance skills and everything to do with that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I know! I've got that part down!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh? Let's see how you would start an interview, then.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right! Hi, my name is Minori Hanasato! My favorite hobby is imitating dance choreography and my special skill is coming up with catchphrases!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I thought up a new catchphrase for today: Like the seed of a dream which grows into a flower, I'm Minori Hanasato♪
It's wonderful to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I give that a two. And that's out of a hundred.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A two?! What did I do wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You failed to give me any clue about what kind of person you are. Your catchphrase didn't make any sense, either.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're supposed to be showing off your strong points.
In my case, I'd probably focus on how good I am on variety shows, or my ability to roll with sudden, absurd requests.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's true! You've been on more variety shows than I can count! It was always so much fun watching you interacting with the other guests!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As long as those watching the show think so, that's what matters.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm not really sure what my strong points are.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: From what I've seen so far, I'd say it's that annoying tenacity of yours. Maybe you should focus on that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My tenacity? Doesn't everyone work hard, though?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You'd be surprised how many people find it hard to keep working hard at something all by themselves. I agree that could definitely work as a strong point.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think the fact that you persevered despite failing fifty times could make an interesting backstory.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I guess that makes sense!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Maybe we should skip the dance practice today and work on your interview and introduction skills.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we're not stopping until you're able to do it perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's certainly determined, I'll give her that. I might be able to have even more fun teasing her than I do you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It makes me think of how you were back when I first started. You were so strict.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This much is nothing, you know.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Shizuku. About that conversation we were having the other day...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nevermind... It's been a long day. I'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah... See you tomorrow, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that Airi over there! Look! It's Airi Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Airi, as in the one who's always on those variety shows on tv?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Yeah! She used to be an idol, right? I don't really remember her from outside all the shows, though.

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Whatever, let's go talk to her!
Huh? Where'd she go?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ugh...
